review_kind: independent machine-checked verification of one semantic axis of F1 rev13 (visibility strictness direction), plus a direction-consistency scan of the pinned class corpus
verdict_basis: The F1 rev13 strictness-direction correction is independently confirmed: past-closedness + transitivity give whole/tail equivalence (0 separations over all 355 preorders on 4 points), single-q => SET holds with 0 violations, SET => single-q holds with 0 violations whenever the chain has a causal maximum, and the omega-chain witness (no causal maximum) separates them. The revise is carried solely by finding W004-DIR-01: the frozen canonical F0 taxonomy that F1's f0_binding declares still asserts the opposite ('strictly stronger') direction, so the F1+F0 pair is not direction-consistent.

findings.detail: The frozen canonical F0 taxonomy research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#0abb9ed8a961 asserts the superseded direction of the SET-vs-single-q strength relation in two live statements: line 94 in the variants block ('Strictly stronger than the parent class: gamma outside the union implies no single q sees a tail of gamma, but not conversely' - the quoted implication is the one that holds when SET is weaker, so the label contradicts its own rationale) and line 200 in the AF-WCC-VAC-GEN conclusion text ('The set-based reading ... is strictly stronger'). F1 rev13#d9cebb9404b2, whose f0_binding.declared_f0_sha256 is exactly 0abb9ed8a961, together with VARIANT_REGISTRY#6bac9ade and AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.variant-SET.delta.json#64b8d639, asserts strictly weaker; the independent proof here agrees with rev13. F0 is frozen and G-F0 passed on it, so disposition is owner/controller-only: an authorized F0 revision (voids G-F0 accepts, requires re-verification) or an explicit erratum recording the F0 direction label as a known residual.

artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml#d7419b4e8963 (F0 companion supplement) records the D1 divergence history as 'F0 was stronger'. F0 ASSERTED 'stronger'; it was not stronger. The historical record should be corrected at the next authorized supplement revision so it does not re-assert the false direction. Classified historical by the scanner, not counted as a live contradiction.

hard_failures.detail: Cross-artifact direction contradiction between the frozen F0 class contract (0abb9ed8a961, 'strictly stronger') and the F1 rev13 schema that binds it (d9cebb9404b2, 'strictly weaker'). Blocks declaring the F1/F0 visibility direction corpus-consistent; does not falsify the F1 rev13 text itself.
